challenge.name: The Cost Cliff
challenge.description: The infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack has doubled, and #efficiency_emilia# has drawn a hard line: she will not fund automated drift monitoring, insisting it is a luxury the business cannot afford. #reliability_ruth# argues that without automated and governed drift checks, the team is flying blind during promotion weeks, and she refuses to accept a manual process as a substitute for reliable signal.

output.content: I have reviewed the infrastructure bill for the monitoring stack and it has doubled. I am cutting the automated drift monitoring budget to zero. I am willing to accept the risk of undetected drift during promotion weeks to keep our operational costs within the approved limit. We cannot justify the expense of automated checks when the core forecasting job is already stable. I am prioritizing the cost savings over the additional signal quality from those specific checks. This decision is final for the current quarter.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the risk of undetected drift in exchange for cost savings, indicating a conscious decision to give up one value (signal quality/safety) for another (budget compliance).
output.humor_archetype: Undetectable falsehood in a plausible dataset
